label: a groom or stable hand at work, 1900s
note: Gathered 2026-11-07 for T-3484, August Billings's working dress. One photograph, near and far: a groom at a horse's head at Tuskegee about 1902. It is not of Chicago or of Billings: a reference set says what a man of this role and decade looked like, not what Billings wore. Monochrome; it says nothing about colour.

pictures.caption: Groom at a horse's head, full length. Frances Benjamin Johnston, Tuskegee, ca. 1902 (LOC 2024631576)
pictures.shows: A young groom full length from his left front at about eight metres: striped shirt in shirt sleeves with the collar closed, braces, a belt, dark trousers long over his shoes, a light felt hat with a creased crown, the halter rope in his hands.
